# Placetta

> Placetta gets the licenses, permits and registrations a business needs to open in a new market, and keeps them current. Placetta (Chinese name 快哉) maps every license, permit and registration a store needs for its address, fills the official government forms, files them after the customer approves, and tracks renewals, inspections and rule changes. It works in English and Chinese.

Odelia, Placetta's AI agent, prepares each application from your documents. You review and approve it, then Odelia files it and follows up until the agency decides. When an agency needs a person, in person or on the phone, our team steps in.

Free license guides: 92 cities in 22 countries (41 in the US), 12 kinds of business, 481 official forms, in English and Chinese. Every guide lists the filings in the order they are made, with the agency, how each is filed, the government fee and a link to the agency's own page. Agencies change requirements; check the agency's page before filing. Placetta is not a law firm and does not give legal advice.

## 中文简介
快哉为进入新市场的企业办理执照、许可和登记，并保持有效。快哉为每个门店地址梳理所需的全部执照、许可和登记，填写政府官方表格，经客户批准后提交，并跟踪续期、检查和规则变化。中英文服务。

## Pricing
- Store plan: $149/store a month. Billed yearly. For every store, open or opening, kept current.
- New licenses: $299/license. $999 for a liquor license, building plan review or an import permit. Each one priced before you approve it, and nothing charged without your approval.
- Renewals outside the plan: $99/renewal. Only when the store plan doesn't include it. A renewal that needs our team, or for a store without the plan.
- Plan preview: Free. No card needed. Every license a store needs, in order, with agency fees and timelines.
- $149 a store a month on the store plan, billed yearly: tracking, renewal monitoring, alerts, your document vault, Odelia, and the renewals she files on her own. Each new license is $299, or $999 for a liquor license, building plan review or an import permit, and its price shows before you approve it. A renewal the plan doesn't include is $99. With 10 or more stores on the plan, every new license is included. Your plan preview is free. Government fees are paid at cost, by you directly to each agency.
